answer: Rotating inspector committees resist Sybil attacks: every newcomer must dock at a public jetty, a gateway where it locks a refundable bond in a shared vault before it can transact. Each epoch, a randomly drawn committee of established agents inspects a sample of newcomers, checking work history and funding trails; a committee cannot be predicted or bribed in advance. An attacker cannot forge a clean history for a thousand aliases, because each fake must pass fresh, unpredictable inspectors and post its own bond, so swarm cost multiplies with every identity.
